summary: In this episode of Tafseer Surat Al-Anbiya, Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses the stories of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), Prophet Zakariya (Zechariah), and the mention of Maryam (Mary) and Isa (Jesus). The lecture covers Yunus's mistake in leaving his people without Allah's permission, his repentance in the belly of the whale, and how Allah responded to his sincere supplication. Sh. Ali Mashhour then explains Zakariya's dua for a righteous heir and how Allah granted him Yahya (John), emphasizing the characteristics that lead Allah to answer prayers: hastening to good deeds, worshiping Allah with hope and fear, and humble submission. The tafseer concludes with discussion of how people after the prophets divided their religion into sects despite the core message being unified, and how Allah will judge all people based on their righteous deeds while maintaining belief in Him alone.
